name: Ramapo Mini Camps
description_short: Ramapo's half day camps, 9 am to 1 pm, for children age 4 by December 31 (toilet trained) through entering grade 5, at Connor Elementary School and Suffern Middle School. Days mix games, arts and crafts, music and drama with themed days and visiting entertainers.
refund_policy_summary: Refund requests go in writing to the Parks & Recreation Department; medical refunds need a doctor's note. No refunds once a program has begun, and a $50 per camper surcharge applies to cancellations.

fees.name: Payment plan fee
fees.note: Per family, only for families who choose the payment plan (minimum $500 deposit, in person, started by May 15)

fees.name: Late enrollment increase
fees.note: Charged per child on mini camp enrollments after June 12, 2026

fees.name: Cancellation surcharge
fees.note: Per camper, charged on a refund for a cancelled camp

fees.name: Ice cream truck
fees.note: Campers bring $4 on Wednesdays to take part

notes: Price is the non-resident rate ($600); Ramapo residents pay $500. Non-residents could register from June 1 if space allowed. 9 am to 1 pm, Monday to Friday. When checked, Connor Elementary was full (waitlist) and Suffern Middle School had space. Locations subject to change.
